title: 異世界サマーバケーション

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Subaru's efforts, the bonds formed across worlds resonated. Together, those bonds destroyed the white whales. With peace restored to the seas, their long-awaited summer vacation can finally resume.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルの奔走により集まった異世界の絆。
その全員の力を合わせ、彼らはシロクジラを撃破した。
海の平穏を取り戻した彼らは、念願のサマーバケーションを再開する──

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: That said, we've formed quite the group now
text_block_list.orig_text:
しっかし、
大所帯になったよなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Everyone♪! To celebrate our big victory, let's all have a big meal together☆!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさーん♪
大勝利記念です！　
みんなで盛大にごはんを食べましょう☆

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Lady Emilia, this is called tropical juice, apparently. Lord Great Spirit you're welcome to some as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
エミリア様、
こちらトロピカルジュースだそうです。
大精霊様もどうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Rem. However you should also take a break.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがと、レム。
レムも
ちゃんと休まなきゃダメよ？

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Quite the strangely colored drink, isn't it? I truly wonder how it tastes... Ah, this is delicious♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
にゃんとも変わった色の飲み物だね？
味の想像がつかないや……
あ、
これおいしい♪

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Barusu said that when you come to the sea, you have to eat fried noodles. I need to make sure Barusu isn't lying again. Rem, bring me some fried noodles.
text_block_list.orig_text:
海に来たら焼きそばを食べるもの、
とバルスが言っていたわ。
バルスがまた嘘を言っていないか確かめる必要があるわね。
レム、
焼きそばを持ってきてちょうだい。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Why are those twin maids so damn different in their behaviour... But...Look, Ram, I brought you some delicious, delicious fried noodles~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
双子メイドのくせにこの違いはなんなのよ……
でも……
ほらラム、
おいしいおいしい焼きそば持ってきてあげたわよ～？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Kyaru, you seem to have put a lot of peppers in those fried noodles of yours earlier... Surely you're not going to give those to Lady Ram, are you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルさま。
先ほど焼きそばに
トウガラシをたくさん入れていたようですが……
それをラムさまにお渡しするつもりじゃありませんよね？

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, I haven't really swam just yet... Maybe I'll eat after I swim a little. How about you, Kyouka-chan?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえばあたし、
まだ泳いでなかったわね……
食べるのは
ちょっと泳いでからにしようかしら。
キョウカちゃんもどう？

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Um, I still don't really know how to swim...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
あの、
私まだ泳ぐのに自信がなくて……

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: Well, I have a good idea for you both then. There's a rubber boat I've prepared right here, so we could use this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それならいいものが。
ゴムボートがありますので、
こちらを使えばいいでしょう。

text_block_list.name: Kyoka
text_block_list.text: Wow... That looks like a lot of fun...♪ Then I might be good...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わぁっ……
楽しそう……♪
それならいいかも……！

text_block_list.name: Neneka
text_block_list.text: It's a perfect size for two people, you and me. We also have just the right amount of powerforce for it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私と貴方の二人なら
十分乗れるサイズでしょう。
動力もちょうどよく捕まったことですし。

text_block_list.name: Saren
text_block_list.text: Hey... that "powerforce", that'd be me, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
その動力って
あたしのことじゃないわよね？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Hey, Ranpha-chan... why don't you come a little closer?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ
ランファちゃん、
もう少し
こっちに来たらどうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Ranpha
text_block_list.text: No, um... I'll just linger around here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いえ、
あの……
わたしは、
この辺りで……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Okay well, then it's fine for this teacher to come towards you then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ、
先生がそっちに行くのはいいかしら。

text_block_list.name: Ranpha
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! There's actually a lot of things I want to ask you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……は、
はい……！
いろいろと……
お聞きしたいことも、
あるので……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: The beach sure is nice... as I always say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──海っていいもんだよなぁ、
やっぱり。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hey, bro. Are you sure you don't want to go hang around with them? I'm the only one here who can't stand being surrounded by girls in swimsuits, so here I am being a sentimental guy who fidgets in the corner and watches.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう兄弟。
あっちに行かなくていいのか？
こっちにゃ
水着の女の子に囲まれるのがいたたまれなくて、
隅っこで
もじもじしながら見てるだけの
センチメンタルな俺しかいねぇぞ？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I'll consider that an honor then. So, what is it? You've got a love story to tell? Tell me if there's a girl you like over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そいつは光栄だな。
で、
なんだ？　
恋バナか？
好きな子いるんだったら教えろよー

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...But even so, bro, you've truly been through a lot.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……
にしても兄弟、
お前も苦労してるよな。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Something like amnesia... You've been in that state many times, haven't you? It seems a lot of people around you knew about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何度も記憶喪失……
『あの状態』になってるんだろ？
いろんな人が知ってたもんな。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I don't really think I want to get used to it?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 慣れたくはねぇよ！？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: To be honest, just remembering myself babbling over Emilia-tan makes my face get hot in embarassment...
text_block_list.orig_text:
俺は正直、
エミリアたんにばぶばぶ言ってる自分の姿とか
思い出すだけで
顔面が熱くなってくるぜ……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... Not to add how a lot of other people saw me like that...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
ほかにもいろんな奴に見られちまったし……

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Oh, I believe most of them saw me like that "Before" atleast. No, no, don't worry about it. Don't mind me. I'm just talking at random.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
いろんな奴に見られたのは前か。
いやいや
気にすんな気にすんな、
こっちの話だ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Well, at any rate, that just means you're an amazing person! Everyone worked hard just for you and at the end you managed to get us all' through this time too, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ
とにかく、
お前はすごいやつってことだよ！
みんながお前のために動いてくれて、
今回も何とかなっただろ？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I feel a bond with you. That kind of thing is a powerful thing. I honestly respect what you've accomplished and built up with all these people.
text_block_list.orig_text:
絆を感じる
っていうかさ。
そういうのって、
すげぇパワーになるんだな。
お前が積み上げてきたもの、
素直に尊敬するぜ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? What, hey? You're leaving already? We haven't even had a toast yet~
text_block_list.orig_text:
……え？
なんだよおい、
もう行っちまうのか？　
まだ乾杯も──

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Subaru?
text_block_list.orig_text: ──スバル？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: E-Emilia-tan?! ...W-Was that guy trying to be considerate with me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
エ、
エミリアたん！？
……気を使ってくれたのか
あいつ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: ...Subaru, you’ve been working hard on your own again, haven’t you? Even though I told you not to do anything reckless.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……スバル、
また一人で頑張ってくれてたのね。
無茶しないでって、
言ったのに。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: C-Come on, Emilia-tan, you jest. I was just running around in embarrassment because I was doing stuff like “babuu” and “ogyaa” just a second earlier, you know?
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やだなぁエミリアたんってば。
俺は
ほら、
自分が
「ばぶー」とか
「おぎゃー」とか
やらかしてた恥ずかしさで、
逃げ回ってただけだよ？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh come on, stop messing around like that. I know exactly what you've been doing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もう、
またそうやってふざけて。
ちゃんと分かってるんだからね。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Hahaha... All I did was ask everyone to gather at a certain place. They fought the white whale together because Emilia and the others had formed a bond with them beforehand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ははは……。
俺はただ、
みんなに来てくれってお願いしただけだよ。
一緒にシロクジラと戦ってくれたのは、
エミリアたちがみんなと絆を結んだからだ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I was able to become friends with everyone because I was taking care of Lorik all that time. Subaru, if you hadn't returned back to normal, I could've taken care of you too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなと仲良くなれたのは、
あの子のお世話をしてたからよ。
スバルも元に戻ってなかったら
お世話してあげられたのに。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: No, seriously, give me a break here! Don't try to instill a forbidden fetish of baby play within me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやほんっと勘弁してください！
赤ちゃんプレイの趣味を俺に植え付けようとしないで！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I don't really get what you're saying, but... Anyway, thank you, Subaru. You say that's not the case, but it's all thanks to you that everyone was right there to help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはよくわかんないけど……
とにかくありがとう、
スバル。
スバルはそうじゃないって言うけど、
やっぱり
みんなが助けにきてくれたのは
スバルのおかげよ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...I'll gladly accept your kind words.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……労いの言葉は、
ありがたく受け取っておくよ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Ehehe♪
text_block_list.orig_text: ふふっ♪

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: *sigh* Come to think of it, Emilia-tan. We might have gone through a difficult ordeal, but... How was the beach?
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
そういやエミリアたん。
色々と大変だったかもしれないけどさ。
……海はどうだった？

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I had so much fun. I went into the sea, and I played "Volley buhl"... Also a lot of different people taught me how to take care of kids!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごーく楽しかった。
海に入ったり、
『ばれえぼおる』をしたり……
それに、
いろんな人から
子どものお世話の仕方を教えてもらったの。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I know. I did actually experience it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ああ、
知ってる。
実際に味わったし。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Eh?
text_block_list.orig_text: え？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, it's nothing. But damn, what a shame. I wanted to become a parenting expert together with Emilia-tan too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーいやなんでもない。
でも惜しかったなぁ、
俺もエミリアたんと一緒に
子育てエキスパートになりたかったぜ！

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: I don't know about an 'exp-ertuh', but... yeah. It was a really fun experience.
text_block_list.orig_text:
『えきすぱあと』はわからないけど……
そうね。
すごーく楽しい経験ができたわ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Now I'll be ready to have a baby anytime I desire.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで
いつ赤ちゃんが出来ても大丈夫ね。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Th-That means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
それって……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: What’s wrong, Subaru?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたの？　
スバル？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: No, ummmmm... Sorry, my processing power might be at its limit due to that bombshell you just dropped...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
その……
ごめん、
爆弾発言に俺の処理能力の限界かも……

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: SU-BA-RUUUU? Are you thinking of something lewd once more?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ス～
バ～
ル～？
なんかよからぬことを考えてないかな～？

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: WHOAAAA, THAT GAVE ME A FRIGHT! Where did you come from, father-in-law?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おわぁ
びっくりした！
どっから現れたんだよお義父さん！

text_block_list.name: Puck
text_block_list.text: Subaru, I don't recall allowing you to call me Father-in-law.
text_block_list.orig_text: スバルがお義父さんと呼ぶのを許した覚えはないね。

text_block_list.name: Ram
text_block_list.text: Barusu, you did well this time, considering it's you we're talking about. Ram wanted to personally reward you so she brought you some yakisoba noodles. Eat this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回はバルスにしてはよくやったわね。
ラムが直々に労ってあげようと思って焼きそばを持ってきてあげたわ。
食べなさい。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Nee-sama thanking me like this sure is a rare sight. Well then, I won't hesitate to dig in.... HMMMMM!!! WHAT'S WITH THIS! HOOOT! DID YOU PUT HABANERO IN THIS?!?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉様が俺に
って
珍しいこともあるもんだ。
そんじゃあ
遠慮なく、
いただきま
──
かっれぇ！！！
なんだよこれ、
ハバネロでも入れた！？

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: Subaru-kun, here have some water.
text_block_list.orig_text:
スバルくん、
どうぞお水です。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Rem. You really are considerate... Actually, if you had this water prepared beforehand, I wish you had stopped Ram first...
text_block_list.orig_text:
サンキューレム。
やっぱレムは気が利くぜ……
ってか、
あらかじめ水を用意してるんだったら、
ラムを止めてほしかったぜ……

text_block_list.name: Rem
text_block_list.text: I wanted you to experience my sister’s kindness as well, Subaru-kun. Apart from that, I predicted that your tongue would go numb, so I prepared some cold water for you. I've also prepared some sweet juice.
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉様の優しさを
スバルくんにも味わって欲しかったんです。
それとは別に
舌が痺れるのは予測できましたので、
冷たいお水をご用意しておきました。
甘いジュースもありますよ。

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: I suppose Nee-sama's kindness gets straight to the point...
text_block_list.orig_text: 姉様の優しさが尖りまくってるんだよな……

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Everyone looks like they're having so much fun.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
みんな、
すごーく楽しそう。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: As you can see, the beach during summer has the power to make anyone smile like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
夏の海は、
みんなを笑顔にする力があるんですよ。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Yes, it’s true. It’s just as Subaru said.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
本当ね。
スバルの言った通りだわ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: This time... No, this time as well, thank you very much, Emilia. Thanks to you, we were able to protect this joyful summer time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今回は……
いえ、
今回も
本当にありがとうございました、
エミリアちゃん。
おかげで
楽しい夏の海を守ることができました。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Oh, there's no need to thank us. We're enjoying this "Summah Vaca-shun" too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
お礼なんていいのよ。
私たちだって
『さまぁばけぇしょん』を楽しんでるんだもの。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Besides, this time I was even able to become an "Exp-ertuh" in how to deal with kids.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに、
今回は
子どものお世話の
『えきすぱあと』にもなれたし。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: ...How naive.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──それは甘いです。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: Kokkoro...?
text_block_list.orig_text: コッコロちゃん……？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: You are still only at the start of your journey of raising a child, Lady Emilia.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ子育て道は
道半ばでございますよ、
エミリアさま。

text_block_list.name: Emilia
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: There are a thousand different ways to raise a child. Lady Emilia... you've only learned a small part.
text_block_list.orig_text:
子育てのやり方は
千差万別。
エミリアさまは
その一端を知ったに過ぎません。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Ah, sure that's right. There are still many more girls like that in this world...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
確かにそうね。
この世界にはまだまだいるわよ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: The "Mama" types, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text: ママってやつが。

text_block_list.name: Emilia Subaru
text_block_list.text: Mama...!?

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Oh, look over there! Maybe it's because the commotion has subsided, but everyone's come here☆!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
向こうを見てください！
騒ぎが収まったからですかね、
みんなが来ましたよ☆

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Hey~yyyyy♪ Everyone, over here~! Allow us to introduce you to our friends from another world~♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～いっ♪
みんな、
こっちですー！
異世界から来たお友達を、
ご紹介しますよー♪

text_block_list.name: Subaru
text_block_list.text: THERE'S STILL SO MANY MAMAS IN HERE?!?!
text_block_list.orig_text: まだこんなにママいんの！？

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A new encounter with people overflowing with maternal love. The bonds he made with those people from another world will continue to deepen...
text_block_list.orig_text:
母性溢れる者たちとの新たなる邂逅。
異世界の絆はさらに広がり、
そして深まってゆく──

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Phew, looks like this ordeal's finally over and dealt with.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──ふぅ、
やっと片付いたようね。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: Seriously. I've never had to deal with another world intervening like this. Unpredictable things always happen around here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まったく。
異世界の介入とか金輪際ごめんだわ。
予測不能なことばかり起きるし。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I'm glad he seems to be happy about this meeting, and he seems to really treasure those bonds he formed with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ま、
あいつはこの出会いを喜び、
結ばれた絆を大事に思ってるみたいだけどさ。

text_block_list.name: Echidna
text_block_list.text: That's right. Meeting the unknown is a precious thing, and forming bonds with it is important too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだね。
未知との出会いは尊く、
絆は重要なものだ。

text_block_list.name: Echidna
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to say it was an interesting and valuable experience for me as well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ボクとしても
興味深い体験をさせてもらったよ。

text_block_list.name: Echidna
text_block_list.text: Towards the end of the fight there, it seems as if our conversation connected to their world to help them. Was that your doing?
text_block_list.orig_text:
最後にうっかりこっちの会話が
向こうに繋がってしまったようだが、
あれは君の仕業かい？

text_block_list.name: Echidna
text_block_list.text: Why are you ignoring me? We've also made a bond here, so let's deepen our friendship.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうして無視をするのかな？
せっかく結ばれた縁だ、
もっと親交を深めようじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Echidna
text_block_list.text: Right, Ameth?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねぇ、
アメス。

text_block_list.name: Ameth
text_block_list.text: YOU SHOULD HURRY UP AND GO HOOMMMMEEEEEEEEE!
text_block_list.orig_text: あんたはさっさと帰りなさいよーーーーーっ！
